meaning: Selected standalone public records; the full original stays local. Original input hashes are provenance commitments, not a claim that the original mixed input or raw response is packaged.
records: Empty state is losing; last-brick removal wins.
Sorted positive wall lengths; the player to move is implicit since both players have identical moves.
Choose wall n, r in {1,2} with r<=n, and offset0<=i<=n-r; replace n by the nonzero parts i and n-r-i.
Increasing total bricks, all successors are earlier. Winning iff some successor is losing; losing iff every successor is winning.
